author: National Geographic
description:
In the first full episode of Kingdom of the Mummies from National Geographic, travel deep beneath the desert sands of Saqqara as archaeologists discover what lies inside a hidden chamber. 

Join archaeologists as they unseal a 2,600-year-old subterranean complex to reveal ancient Egypt’s first fully intact funeral home. This historic discovery provides long-sought insights into the sacred business of death, mummification, and Egyptian burial rituals. Step inside the underground chambers to see the discoveries that redefined our understanding of how this ancient civilization prepared for the afterlife.
